items.html: And the second aspect is that after the Partzuf of Rachel herself has been corrected through the charity and the gifts to the poor, there still needs to be an illumination that is sustained in her, in the secret of her own Mochin, which are clothed within her Partzuf of ten Sefirot at the time of the dormita, as is known. And that illumination in her Mochin must be sustained all those days called Purim and remain there enduring, even if the Mochin of Aba and Ima depart after the dormita and she returns face to face; nevertheless the illumination of those Mochin will remain enduring in her Mochin and will not depart entirely, as in the other times, as stated above. And this matter depends on the observance of another commandment, namely to make the Purim feast, a feast and joy.
